en.check.no_paths: This node has no path to the peer, so there is nothing to check.
en.codes.address_hint: host:port, if the addresses in the code cannot be reached from here.
en.codes.addresses: Address at which the other node reaches this one
en.codes.addresses_hint: host:port, several separated by commas. Empty: the addresses the node was started with.
en.codes.code_hint: Paste the whole code that the other node made.
en.codes.create_intro: The other node connects to this node with the code. It works once.
en.codes.made_intro: Copy this code and enter it on the other node.
en.codes.made_once: This code is shown only once. Anyone who has it can pair with this node until it is used or expires, so send it over a channel you trust.
en.codes.title: Pairing codes that have not been used
en.col.name: Name
en.login.hint: The password is the one set when the node was started. If none was set, the node made one at its first start and wrote it to its log once.
en.login.intro: Log in to manage this node.
en.msg.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
en.paths.addr_hint: host:port of the peer's listener, or of whatever carries the connection there.
en.paths.delete_text: Sessions that are in progress keep the connections they have.
en.paths.none: No path, so this node cannot open connections to the peer.
en.paths.proxy_hint: socks5://host:port. A user and password are stored but never shown. Leave the address as it is to keep them.
en.paths.role_repair: repairs (data that has to be sent again)
en.paths.sec_owncert: TLS with the peer's own certificate
en.paths.security_hint: Choose "off" only for a path that is already encrypted by something else.
en.paths.title: Paths
en.paths.verify: How to check the certificate (own certificate only)
en.paths.verify_hint: By the fingerprint of its key, or the way a browser does, by authority and host name.
en.peers.allow_hint: Networks with an optional port or range, separated by commas. Empty: any destination this node can reach.
en.peers.intro: A peer is another tcpraid node that this node is paired with. Pair once, and after that either node can make rules towards the other.
en.peers.no_addresses: none: this node cannot connect to the peer
en.peers.none: No peer yet. Create a pairing code here and enter it on the other node, or the other way round.
en.peers.remove_text: Its sessions are reset and its connections are refused from now on. The other node is not told. Rules that name this peer stay. A node that is paired later under the same name takes them over, so delete or change them if that is not wanted.
en.peers.title: Peers
en.peers.udp_dial: UDP feedback address of the peer
en.peers.udp_hint: host:port of the peer's UDP feedback listener. Empty: feedback travels on the TCP connections only.
en.rules.delete_text: The rule stops listening. Sessions that are in progress run to their end.
en.rules.destination_hint: HOST:port or HOST:first-last, where HOST is an IP address or a host name that the peer looks up. A range must be as long as the range of the listen address.
en.rules.destination_label: Destination address and port at the peer
en.rules.intro: A rule listens on this node and carries every connection it gets to a destination at a peer, over several connections at once.
en.rules.listen_hint: IP:port, or IP:first-last for a range of ports. Leave the IP out (":5000") to listen on every address.
en.rules.match_hint: Networks with an optional port or range of ports, separated by commas: 192.0.2.0/24:873, [2001:db8::/32]:5000-5010
en.rules.no_peers: There is no peer yet. Pair with one first.
en.rules.none: No rule yet. Pair with a peer, then make one.
en.rules.title: Forwarding rules
en.rules.transparent_intro: Transparent rules decide where connections go that the host redirects to this node. They need the node to be started with a transparent listener. The first rule that matches a connection takes it.
en.sessions.title: Sessions
en.settings.docs_text: See the README and the docs directory that come with the program.
en.settings.node_name_hint: Peers keep the name the node had when they were paired with it.
en.settings.title: Settings

zh.check.no_paths: 本节点没有通往这个对端的路径，没有可检查的。
zh.codes.address: 改用这个地址连接（可选）
zh.codes.address_hint: host:port,当配对码里的地址从这里连不到时填写。
zh.codes.addresses: 对方用什么地址连到本节点
zh.codes.addresses_hint: host:port,多个用逗号分隔。留空：用节点启动时设置的地址。
zh.codes.code_hint: 粘贴另一个节点生成的完整配对码。
zh.codes.create_intro: 另一个节点凭配对码连接到本节点。配对码只能用一次。
zh.codes.made_intro: 复制这个配对码，到另一个节点上输入。
zh.codes.made_once: 配对码只显示这一次。在它被使用或过期之前，拿到它的人都可以和本节点配对，所以请通过可信的渠道传给对方。
zh.codes.title: 未使用的配对码
zh.col.name: 名字
zh.login.hint: 密码是启动节点时设置的那个。如果没有设置，节点在第一次启动时生成了一个，并在日志里显示过一次。
zh.msg.copy_failed: 复制失败，请手动选中文字复制。
zh.paths.addr_hint: 对端监听的 host:port,或者通往它的入口的 host:port。
zh.paths.delete_text: 正在进行的会话保留已有的连接。
zh.paths.none: 没有路径，本节点无法向这个对端发起连接。
zh.paths.proxy_hint: socks5://host:port。用户名和密码会保存但不显示。地址保持原样即可保留它们。
zh.paths.security_hint: 只有路径已经被别的工具加密时才选「关闭」。
zh.paths.title: 路径
zh.paths.verify: 怎样核对证书（仅自有证书）
zh.paths.verify_hint: 按证书密钥的指纹核对，或者像浏览器那样按签发机构和主机名核对。
zh.peers.allow: 对端可以访问的目的地
zh.peers.allow_hint: 网段，可带端口或端口段，用逗号分隔。留空：本节点能连到的任何目的地。
zh.peers.intro: 对端是和本节点配对过的另一个 tcpraid 节点。配对一次之后，任意一边都可以建通往另一边的规则。
zh.peers.no_addresses: 无：本节点连不到这个对端
zh.peers.none: 还没有对端。在这里生成配对码，到另一个节点上输入，或者反过来。
zh.peers.remove_text: 它的会话会被重置，它的连接从现在起被拒绝。另一个节点不会收到通知。指向这个对端的规则会保留。以后用同一个名字配对的节点会接手这些规则。如果不希望这样，请删除或修改它们。
zh.peers.title: 对端
zh.peers.udp_dial: 对端的 UDP 回执地址
zh.peers.udp_hint: 对端 UDP 回执监听的 host:port。留空：回执只走 TCP 连接。
zh.rules.delete_text: 规则停止监听。正在传的会话会跑完。
zh.rules.destination_hint: 主机:端口 或 主机:起-止，主机可以是 IP 地址，也可以是由对端解析的主机名。端口段的长度必须和监听的端口段相同。
zh.rules.destination_label: 对端那边的目的地址和端口
zh.rules.intro: 规则在本节点上监听，把收到的每条连接用多条连接并行送到对端那边的目的地。
zh.rules.listen_hint: IP:端口，或 IP:起-止 表示一段端口。不写 IP(":5000")表示监听所有地址。
zh.rules.none: 还没有规则。先和对端配对，再新建一条。
zh.rules.title: 转发规则
zh.rules.transparent_intro: 透明规则决定由主机重定向到本节点的连接去往哪个对端。需要节点启动时开了透明监听。按顺序，第一条匹配的规则生效。
zh.sessions.title: 会话
zh.settings.docs_text: 见随程序附带的 README 和 docs 目录。
zh.settings.node_name_hint: 已配对的对端仍然显示配对时的名字。
zh.settings.title: 设置
